title: Invasion landing: planet resources and influence
description: Each planet card in the landing tray now shows its resources and influence (existing icons, tooltips and aria-labels), plus its trait and attachments when the board data has them. Synthetic fixtures, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: One planet
shots.caption: R 2 · I 2 under the planet name, with the trait.

shots.heading: Several planets
shots.caption: Every landable planet shows its values so the target can be chosen by worth. Attachments appear after the trait and their resource/influence modifiers are included in the numbers (the default-target star uses the same numbers).

shots.heading: Phone width (390 px)
shots.caption: The line wraps instead of overflowing.

shots.heading: No trait or attachments
shots.caption: Planets without a trait (or a 0/0 planet) show just the values.
